prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the provided existing panoramic campus-gate landscape background for a website footer.
Primary request: DRASTICALLY REDUCE THE NUMBER OF PLANTS. Remove about 85-90 percent of the original vegetation: the dense tree wall, continuous hedges, flowering shrubs and undergrowth along the fence, and the tree-lined depth behind the gate. Do not replace removed greenery with different shrubs or flowerbeds.
Keep only TWO small, sparse, unobtrusive deciduous trees near the far outer sides of the panorama. Most of the fence and low pale boundary wall should now be visible and uncluttered. Replace the former dense planting areas with quiet light paving, open courtyard space and simple pale ground. Through the gate, show a mostly open campus walkway toward the existing light academic building, not a green avenue.
Preserve the existing blue-and-white entrance gate on the RIGHT, its proportions and architectural details, the low blue fence extending LEFT, the calm blue sky/soft clouds, long continuous foreground pavement, perspective, sunny soft watercolor/editorial paper texture and overall blue/white/cream palette. The result should still unmistakably be a welcoming campus entrance, just much more open and lightly planted.
Composition: same panoramic approximately 3:1 image, edge-to-edge rectangular scene, about 2160:720. Full-width ground so the footer background remains filled on all screen sizes.
No people or characters, bicycle, animals, vehicles, new props, signs, lettering, logos, UI, border or watermark. OPAQUE landscape background; no transparency. Do not bake the website's 13% CSS display opacity into the pixels.
composition: Original blue-and-white campus gate, fence, sky and walkway retained; dense shrubs and tree wall removed, sparse greenery near outer edges.
